name: CoorOfCircle
comment: Returns n points on a circle of radius r centered at (x0, y0). Argument order is r, x0, y0, n. Point k is at angle k*360/n degrees for k = 1 to n, measured from the positive x-axis and increasing counterclockwise. The last point lies on the positive x-axis. The first point is not repeated. This is the same polyline as CoorCircle. Non-numeric input returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
